map.理赔频率：频率 f = 理赔件数 ÷ 风险暴露（件/车年）；联动卡：出险率 =: Claim frequency: f = number of claims ÷ risk exposure (claims/vehicle-year); linked cards: claim rate = f×100 (%), average interval between claims = 1÷f (years, f=0 falls back to 1), per-thousand rate = f×1000 (‰). Validation: number of claims and risk exposure must be non-empty valid numbers, and a zero exposure triggers the division-by-zero fallback. Rule: no fixed grading; the claim rate and per-thousand rate always move in proportion at ×100/×1000.
